summary: unarchive options: group, include list for selective extraction, io_buffer_size, keep_newer, and list_files to return archive contents.
questions: How do I extract only certain files from an archive?
How do I avoid overwriting newer files when unarchiving?
How do I get a list of files inside an archive?

answer_card.title: unarchive include, keep_newer, list_files
answer_card.answer_md:
- `include`: only extract these entries (exclusive with `exclude`)
- `keep_newer` (false): don't replace newer existing files
- `list_files` (false): return `files` list
- `io_buffer_size` (65536), `group`
